name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
description: Multi-agent development orchestrator for Claude Code. Coordinates OpenSpec, orchestrator-led planning, Codex review/back-end, and Antigravity/AGY front-end subagents in parallel, with API/UI contracts, consolidated subagent context, a final implementation report and business-level user instructions.

plugins.name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
plugins.description: Orchestrator skill + /orchestrator slash command that drive an OpenSpec -> orchestrator plan -> Codex review -> parallel Codex/Antigravity execution -> review -> consolidated context -> implementation report workflow. Runs a preflight check for agy, codex-cli, openspec-cli and required plugins before starting; cancels operation if anything is missing.
